product_summary: Desktop operator console for Agent Org Network. Operators watch the incoming question queue, review how each question was routed to owner agent cards, arbitrate contested ownership with precedents, and supervise outgoing answers with corrections.
audiences: 질문 라우팅과 답변 품질을 책임지는 운영 매니저
자기 담당 범위(Agent Card)와 지식 번들을 관리하는 팀 담당자

application_concept.primary_job: 운영자가 들어온 질문의 라우팅 상태를 한눈에 보고, 다툼은 판례로 판정하며, 나가는 답을 근거와 함께 승인한다.
application_concept.success_moment: Contested 질문 하나가 판례와 함께 판정되고, 두 담당 지식이 합쳐진 답이 출처가 붙은 채 승인된 상태.
differentiation: 첫 화면은 채팅창이 아니라 라우팅 상태별 질문 큐다.
답변은 항상 어느 Agent Card의 어떤 문서를 근거로 했는지 꼬리표가 붙는다.
다툼 판정 화면에는 과거 판례가 판단 근거로 함께 놓인다.
정정은 원본을 덮지 않고 append-only 기록으로 쌓인다.

layout_skeleton.composition: three-pane split workbench: queue rail, decision surface, evidence inspector
layout_skeleton.navigation_model: left queue rail with top org bar; no bottom tabs (desktop)

primary_regions.name: Org topbar
primary_regions.role: 조직명, 동기화 상태, 검색, 운영자 계정

primary_regions.name: Queue rail
primary_regions.role: Routed/Contested/Unowned 상태별 질문 큐. 선택이 중앙 화면을 바꾼다

primary_regions.name: Decision surface
primary_regions.role: 선택된 질문의 라우팅 근거, 합성된 답변 초안, 출처, 승인 액션

primary_regions.name: Evidence inspector
primary_regions.role: 담당 Agent Card, 관련 판례, 정정 기록

first_screen_contract: 첫 viewport에 큐 레일, 결정 화면, 인스펙터가 동시에 살아 있어야 함
선택된 질문의 라우팅 상태와 후보 점수가 결정 화면에 보여야 함
답변 초안에는 출처 인용이 두 개 이상 붙어 있어야 함
승인/에스컬레이션 액션이 결정 화면 안에 있어야 함
채팅 입력창이 화면의 주인공이 되면 실패
avoid_layouts: chatbot conversation as the main surface

signature_moves: Routing trace: 후보 Agent Card들의 점수와 선정 이유가 결정 화면의 첫 번째 객체다.
Merged answer: 걸친 질문은 두 담당 출처가 나란히 붙은 하나의 답으로 보인다.
Precedent dock: 판정 화면 옆에 과거 판례가 근거로 상주한다.
Append-only corrections: 정정 기록이 타임라인으로 쌓인 걸 보여준다.
repetition_risks: 큐를 모바일 피드처럼 헤어라인 행으로만 처리하는 것
상태 색을 남발해 대시보드처럼 보이는 것
다크 테마 관성으로 세련됨을 흉내 내는 것

component_decision.rationale: AON Desk is a triage workbench: a stateful queue rail, a decision surface with routing evidence and answer provenance, and an evidence inspector. Chat surfaces, metric card grids, and mobile feed patterns are excluded.

core_components.name: app-shell
core_components.decision_reason: The job is triage across three co-present panes, not a single scroll.

core_components.name: org-topbar
core_components.role: Org identity, sync status, search, operator account.
core_components.decision_reason: Operators need org-level status without leaving triage.

core_components.name: queue-rail
core_components.role: Question queue grouped by routing state.

core_components.name: queue-item
core_components.role: One question: snippet, state tag, owner, age.
core_components.decision_reason: Each row is a work item, not a message bubble.

core_components.name: routing-state-tag
core_components.decision_reason: The three routing outcomes are the product's core vocabulary.

core_components.name: routing-trace
core_components.role: Candidate agent cards with scores and match reasons.
core_components.decision_reason: Why-this-owner evidence is the first object of the decision surface.

core_components.name: candidate-score-row
core_components.role: One candidate: agent id, scope match, score bar.

core_components.name: answer-draft
core_components.role: Assembled answer text with inline provenance markers.
core_components.decision_reason: The answer is a supervised document, not a chat reply.

core_components.name: source-citation
core_components.role: One cited document with owner agent and path.
core_components.decision_reason: Every answer carries its evidence tags.

core_components.name: agent-card-panel
core_components.role: Owner identity, scope, knowledge bundle status.
core_components.decision_reason: The inspector grounds decisions in the card registry.

core_components.name: precedent-entry
core_components.role: One past ruling with question pattern and decision.

core_components.name: correction-timeline
core_components.role: Append-only list of corrections on an answer.
core_components.decision_reason: Supervision history must be visible and immutable.

core_components.name: approve-action
core_components.role: Approve the answer draft for sending.
core_components.decision_reason: Approval is the operator's success action.

core_components.name: escalate-action
core_components.role: Send the question to a human manager.
core_components.decision_reason: The no-question-dropped invariant needs a visible exit.

core_components.name: sync-status
core_components.decision_reason: Answer quality depends on bundle freshness.

rejected_components.name: chat-composer
rejected_components.reason: The console supervises answers; it does not chat.

rejected_components.name: metric-card-grid
rejected_components.reason: Operational counts live in the rail, not a KPI wall.

rejected_components.name: post-feed
rejected_components.reason: A mobile feed grammar would repeat the previous mocks.

rejected_components.name: modal-wizard
rejected_components.reason: Arbitration happens in-pane with evidence co-present.

notes: Manual violet pick (Royal Purple): teal appears in 14/16 registry entries and greens dominated the auto candidates; the arbitration/precedent domain justifies the violet weight.
Routing states use semantic success/warning/danger tokens, kept small.
